opportunity: At -O0 each C local has its own spill slot. The dataflow folds the stored value into its readers, so framelayout reports the emptied slot from an early pass as the width-only undefinedN while the C body prints the value as char * (or FILE *, passwd *, ...). 805 of the 1,625 ground-truth char * variables Binary Ninja gets and kuna missed on the campaign's 444 slices were such slots.
test_name: kuna-console verify_slotptr (two-pass e2e over every function of fauxware) + 6 unit tests in kuna_slotptr/tests.rs + the tests/cli probe pair slotptr-types-a-spilled-string-slot{,-option-off}
inspiration: Binary Ninja types each -O0 spill slot from the value stored into it

witness.before: local_1f0 undefined8, local_1e8 undefined8, local_1e0 undefined8
witness.after: local_1f0 passwd *, local_1e8 char *, local_1e0 char *
witness.in_repo_equivalent: fauxware authenticate: local_28 / local_20 (the spilled char * arguments) undefined8 -> char *; local_30 (call return-address pushes, non-zero constants) keeps undefined8

sweep.surface: kuna decompile-all --json, --option slotptr off vs the new default, every function compared field by field
sweep.binaries: coreutils fmt/ls/sort at O0 and O2, bash O2, tar O0

benchmark.corpus: frozen decbench C corpus (results/full_run_address_2026-09-11), 444 slices: coreutils grep gzip diffutils bzip2 findutils tar shadow at O0/O2/O2-noinline
benchmark.arms: off = --option slotptr off, on = the new default; same build
benchmark.worse_cause: each slot takes the type kuna's own C body already gives the stored value, and that type is wrong (pointer difference printed as pointer arithmetic; a register variable merging an lseek result with an errno pointer)

speed.method: interleaved min-of-15 whole-binary kuna decompile-all --json, --option slotptr off vs on, same build (docs/features/slotptr/measure/speed.py)
speed.note: a first run before record_pass was narrowed to the stack space read fmt +3.76 / sort +7.88 min (median +1.3 / +1.33) on a box at load 36-51; the narrowing leaves the output byte-identical

notes: JSON surface only. Recording is gated on ArchContext::slot_ptr, so slotptr off does no extra work.
